whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cafe Network Dice n Dine,

I noticed your cafe has great 4.2★ reviews on Khagaul Road in Mithapur, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile booking and menu page for table reservations.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food menu, aur board game zone highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dicendine

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Cafe Network Dice n Dine, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservations and a board game showcase for your Khagaul Road location in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
